subject: Solution steps need GR review — thin questions padded with generic step
body: GR — During the bulk field audit, gp-field-fixer.js padded any solution_steps arrays under 3 items with a generic step: 'Check your work by substituting the answer back into the original equation.' This is a placeholder only. Please review the affected questions and write proper solution steps that actually walk through the math. To find affected questions: node scripts/gp-missing-fields.js — this now reports which questions had steps padded. All 10 RP exams were affected to varying degrees. Baseline: tests/gp-solution-steps.test.js currently passes 150/150 (all have >= 3 steps), but some of those steps are the generic placeholder. GR should review and replace generics with exam-specific worked solutions.
